input: Set up a rain barrel for garden watering

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Whether this means buying a new barrel, repurposing an existing container, or installing a full multi-barrel system changes the entire plan significantly.
The specific downspout, roof material, and yard layout determine where the barrel can be placed and how it connects to the drainage system.
Knowing if this is a solo DIY project or involves hired help affects how complex the installation steps need to be.
Budget determines whether to buy a purpose-built barrel kit, a repurposed food-grade drum, or a premium system with pumps and filters.
Whether they have tools, a drill, hole saws, and fittings on hand affects whether a hardware run is the immediate first step.
Some users prioritise aesthetics (a decorative barrel that blends into the yard) while others prioritise pure functionality or water capacity.
Understanding what garden size or watering frequency the barrel needs to support determines the required capacity and whether one barrel is enough.

gold.taskTitle: Set up a rain barrel for garden watering
gold.taskDescription: Install and configure a rain barrel system to collect rainwater for use in watering the garden.

questions.title: Do you already have a barrel, or are you buying one?
questions.description: Clarifies whether the task starts with sourcing a container or jumps straight to installation.

questions.title: Which downspout or roof area will feed the barrel?
questions.description: Identifies the physical location and drainage source that determines placement and diverter type needed.

questions.title: Are you doing this yourself or hiring someone?
questions.description: Determines how detailed and step-by-step the installation instructions need to be.

questions.title: What is your budget for this project?
questions.description: Shapes the choice between a basic DIY drum, a mid-range kit, or a premium system with pump and overflow management.

questions.title: Do you have basic tools like a drill and hole saw?
questions.description: Determines whether a tool or hardware run needs to be the very first action before any installation can begin.

questions.title: Does the barrel need to look decorative or just functional?
questions.description: Influences the choice of barrel style, color, and whether screening or planters are added to blend it into the yard.

questions.title: How large is the garden area you need to water?
questions.description: Determines the required storage capacity and whether a single barrel or a linked multi-barrel system is needed.
